rules: Stage 2 uptrend (close > EMA 50/150/200 stacked, EMA 200 rising, >= 30% above the 52-week low, within 25% of the high). Base from the highest swing high of the last 250 days; >= 2 contractions (zigzag 6% on highs/lows), each shallower with a higher low, the last <= 12%, volume drying up in the last one. Buy-stop just above the last contraction's high (pivot) on 1.4x volume; stop = the last contraction's low (max 10% away); sell after a daily close below EMA 50.
backtest: ASX 2008-26: only about 3 setups a year (56 trades, +1.8% a trade); without the volume rule -0.3% a trade. Too few to trust - watch bucket, your call.
